code:
TCP (checkout.northbridgeretail.com):
  SYN -> SYN-ACK -> ACK, then data
  Segment 4 lost -> retransmitted -> delivered in order

UDP (floor-dashboard feed):
  Datagram sent, no handshake
  Update #812 lost -> ignored, #813 arrives on time
caption: TCP spends overhead guaranteeing every segment arrives; UDP spends nothing and moves on.

subtitle: The request-response protocol that rides on top of TCP.
